title: Keystone licensee client app
description: KS_CLIENT_v5_LICENSEE_APPS - one branded client app per licensee. Checked by scripts/licensee/validate.mjs (structure from this schema, plus colour contrast, image sizes and wording keys).

key.description: Same as the folder name and the licensee's company code: 3-32 characters, a-z, 0-9 and dashes.

app_name.description: Name under the icon on the phone and in the stores. Letters, digits, spaces and . , ( ) - only (no & or apostrophes). Keep it short: iPhone shows about 12 characters.

company_name.description: The brokerage's name as shown inside the app (headings, legal text).

bundle_id.description: Reverse-domain bundle id registered in the licensee's Apple Developer account, e.g. com.acmecapital.client. The share extension and widget use <bundle_id>.share and <bundle_id>.widget, and the app group group.<bundle_id>.

team_id.description: Apple Developer Team ID (10 characters). Optional here: the APPLE_TEAM_ID secret wins when set.

application_id.description: Google Play package name, e.g. com.acmecapital.client. Cannot change after the first upload.

server_url.description: The licensee's KS-server address (https, no trailing slash).

client_web_url.description: Where the web version of this licensee's client app is served (https, no trailing slash).

website_url.description: The licensee's public website. Optional; defaults to client_web_url.

primary.description: Buttons, headings and links (replaces Keystone navy).

secondary.description: Accent fills - badges, avatars, highlights (replaces Keystone gold). Text drawn on it uses the primary colour.

wording.description: Overrides for app text, keyed by client-app/src/config/copy.defaults.json. {name}, {year}, {support_email} and {support_phone} are filled in.

icon.description: 1024x1024 PNG, no transparency needed, no rounded corners (the stores round it).

splash.description: 2732x2732 PNG, logo centred on the background colour.

google.description: true to load this family from Google Fonts.

weights.description: Google Fonts weights to load (each must exist for the family). Default [400, 700].

files.description: Font files in this licensee's folder (woff2, woff, ttf or otf). Use either google or files.
